Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 244 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 13"; the free view displayed 5 shipment rows, all imports (origin China/Thailand/Malaysia -> destination India). No row with India as origin, no export B/L, no foreign buyer named for Detergeo. The separate 'Buyers' block on the same page is a generic aggregated list (contains Eicher Motors, Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, Unilever Nepal) and is NOT attributable to this company, so it is not used as evidence.

note: Actual shipment evidence found is IMPORT-side only: 244 India customs records, latest 2026-02-21, with Detergeo as importer of surfactants/ethoxylates (HS 38249900) and pumps (84136090, 84141090) from Thailand, Malaysia and China. This confirms the company is an active operating chemical trader/handler, but it does NOT confirm any export shipments. Declared HS codes 291570/340211/340213/340219 (fatty acids, anionic/non-ionic surfactants) do not match the observed import HS codes 38249900/84136090/84141090 — the observed codes are the factual ones for the trade seen; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected with the caveat that the declared codes are unverified. No export records with date/destination/B-L number were found, and no domestic supply evidence was found: следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено; по внутреннему рынку данных нет. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). Role: trader/manufacturer_trader — not determinable from shipment data alone.
